narr: A slow moving thunderstorm became anchored over the Box Elder area for close to an hour. The storm was severe at times, producing hail and wind gusts to 70 mph. Heavy rainfall of two to over three inches in Box Elder produced flooding and areas of flash flooding.
ev: Over three inches of rain fell in an hour over Ellsworth Air Force Base and parts of Box Elder. Runoff from the heavy rain flooded streets, homes, and businesses. Several streets were flooded on Ellsworth Air Force Base and throughout northern and eastern portions of Box Elder. At least 50 mobile homes were surrounded by water and ten to 15 homes were flooded with water up to six feet deep, mostly along the east side of North Ellsworth Road. Several businesses reported that their parking lots were flooded.
